header.title: Overlays & Portals
header.description: Comprehensive overlay system including modals, dropdowns, tooltips, sheets, and loading states with proper z-index management and accessibility.

modals.title: Modals
modals.description: Modal dialogs with backdrop blur, animation states, and multiple sizes. Includes focus management and keyboard navigation.
modals.exampleBody: This is an example modal using the new overlay design system. It includes proper backdrop handling, focus management, and animation states.

dropdowns.title: Dropdowns
dropdowns.description: Dropdown menus with multiple positioning options, icons, dividers, and keyboard navigation.

tooltips.title: Tooltips
tooltips.description: Lightweight tooltips with multiple positioning options and color variants.

loading.title: Loading Overlays
loading.description: Full-screen and inline loading states with backdrop blur and customizable messaging.

sheets.title: Sheets (Bottom Sheets)
sheets.description: Mobile-first bottom sheets and action sheets that slide up from the bottom of the screen.

contextMenus.title: Context Menus
contextMenus.description: Right-click context menus with keyboard shortcuts and nested submenus.

portal.title: Portal Management
portal.description: Z-index management system and portal utilities for proper overlay stacking.

animationStates.title: Animation States
animationStates.description: Consistent animation states for enter/exit transitions across all overlay components.

bestPractices.title: Best Practices
accessibility: Always provide proper ARIA labels and roles
Support keyboard navigation (Tab, Escape, Arrow keys)
performance: Use React Portals for proper DOM rendering
Implement lazy loading for heavy overlays
Clean up event listeners on unmount
Avoid complex backdrop filters on mobile
uxGuidelines: Keep modals focused on single tasks
Use appropriate overlay types for context
technical: Support both click and keyboard interactions
